result.instructions: Tools for Ceipal, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which open job postings were added in the last 7 days, and who is the recruiter for each?"; "Find the applicant with the email jane@example.com and show her skills and work authorization."; "List the submissions for our Java developer job and their pipeline status.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ceipal data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ceipal_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ceipal_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ceipal_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ceipal_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ceipal_list_job_postings
tools.title: List job postings
tools.description: List job postings, one page at a time. Read only. GET /v2/getJobPostingsList/. Reads are limited to 60 a minute per account token.

page.description: Page number, sent as `page`. The reply carries the vendor's own paging fields.

searchKey.description: Search job code, title and descriptions. Space-separated words mean AND; use double quotes for a phrase.

businessUnitId.description: Business unit id (an id from the Ceipal business units list).

remoteOpportunities.description: 1 for remote jobs, 0 for on-site jobs.

postOnCareerportal.description: 1 for jobs posted on the career portal.

isActive.description: 1 active jobs (default), 0 deleted jobs, 2 archived jobs.

postedAgoDays.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days.

skills.description: Required skills: a technology id or comma-separated skill names.

modifiedAfter.description: Only records modified after this time, for example 2025-06-10 00:00:00.

modifiedBefore.description: Only records modified before this time, for example 2025-06-10 00:00:00.
